reason: Candidate B provides a more direct and well-grounded explanation for the broad premelting and melting range—namely, the role of intrinsic chemical disorder generating local variations in bonding and thus locally depressed melting temperatures. It also offers a clear, falsifiable test via comparing as-synthesized versus annealed (less-disordered) nanoparticles under identical conditions, which is strongly aligned with the known physics of high-entropy alloys at the nanoscale.
